index_calculation: DJI Mavic 3M reflectance (black level, vignetting, gain x exposure, SensorGainAdjustment, sunlight-sensor Irradiance); per-pixel NDVI/NDRE sampled every 1 cm; plant pixels = NDVI > plant_ndvi_min on the plastic beds; values corrected for position in the photo and referred to the photo centre (tile_stress.py --position-correction auto)
map_title: Tomato DAP 10 stressed hotspots and missing-plant gaps (plastic rows)
note: Tomato on plastic mulch ~10 days after transplanting. Seedlings are 3-8 cm, so plant pixels also contain soil or the planting hole and plant NDVI reads ~0.5-0.6. Only NDVI decides (stress_rule 'ndvi'): on the full farm, seedling NDRE differed by +-0.04 between neighbouring tiles - twice the width of a watch band - so it is mostly noise at this stage (it is still measured and reported). A plastic row with fewer than min_plant_pixels plant pixels in a tile is a 'gap' (missing or dead seedlings). require_vegetation stays off: seedlings cover ~2% of a tile. NDVI cuts are starting values - check them against plants in the field.
